title: verbascum masguindalii
intro: Verbascum masguindalii, commonly known as  Yellow Mullein or Mullein, is a perennial flowering plant native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, skin conditions, and anxiety. The health benefits of Verbascum masguindalii include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which may help to soothe sore throats, calm skin irritations, and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function.
